entries.summary: Parse HTML and Markdown through their installed format APIs, show successful conversion warnings, and prepare a replacement editor with imported Word comments through `CommentsPlugin` when available.
migrationNotes: Pass the editor plugin list and an `onImport` editor-owner callback to `ImportToolbarButton`; the button prepares a complete detached replacement before the application swaps editors.

entries.summary: Use diagnosed HTML and Markdown serializers plus `exportDocx`, preserve one chosen accepted, proposed, or review projection, and export attached comment threads as Word comments.
migrationNotes: Use `exportDocx` from `platejs/docx/export`; the `exportToDocx` alias does not exist on `next`.
